decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch that extends the firm’s core cardboard display business, remains publicly offered, and fits the stated push into broader 3D cardboard solutions, management would stay committed and read any weakness as temporary rather than grounds to exit.

Although the online customer portal is more distant from the firm’s traditional offer, the launch still reflects visible investment and supports deeper customer collaboration and stronger information handling, so management would be reluctant to reverse course after only one year.
This product is close to the established offer and its 2024 German packaging award gives management a strong public success signal that reinforces commitment and makes withdrawal very unlikely.

A quarter-pallet cardboard pegboard display sits squarely in the firm’s core competence, was given its own product page, and is easy to justify as part of the announced expansion of 3D cardboard solutions, so management would continue it.

The small cardboard counter display is a close-in extension of the existing portfolio and, given the firm’s public presentation and sunk development effort, management would be inclined to keep it unless clearer failure evidence emerged.

The large freestanding cardboard information display is highly consistent with the firm’s established display business and visible website commitment, so under an escalation-of-commitment logic management would continue backing it.
